course.description: Recorded EDCOR 310 lectures, demonstrations, and course videos across the full course week sequence.

intro.lede: Watch every video in the week-by-week course sequence. Open the plus sign for a warm description, and use the rate controls to tell us what helps.

sections.head: Watch every video.
sections.body: Online students should watch every video in this index and keep a brief record of what they are learning.

sections.head: In-person students.
sections.body: If you are an in-person student, you are expected to be in class. These recordings are an extra resource for review; watching them may not substitute for attendance.

sections.head: Use the plus.
sections.body: Open a unit, then open a week and a video row to see its description and additional details. Each video opens in a new tab.

sections.head: Read the tags.
sections.body: BroPa marks an instructor-made recording. Third party marks a video made by someone else or hosted outside the course.

sections.head: Make time to process.
sections.body: You are welcome to read or watch faster if you choose, but leave time to pause, take notes, connect ideas, and record what you are learning. Speed is useful only when you are still processing the material.

sections.head: Watch actively.
sections.body: As you watch, record the main claim, the evidence or example behind it, and one idea you could explain in your own words.

sections.head: About the times.
sections.body: Times are rough estimates for planning only. Every video in this index belongs to the assigned collection.
